notes.title: Patch Release 1.1.0.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31251370/75dd7ce8ba22d636e598cae77d0e14d63071503c.png
The next update for Spoxel is now live! There are a lot of new features including invasions, placeable NPC's, and AI Changes. I'm starting to gather ideas for the next major patch so be sure to leave some feedback on discord!

Patch Notes
	• Changed which glass block you get from smelting
	• Added trait "Runic Shield"
	• Added item "Runic Shield Rune"…. Which probably does what you'd expect ;)
	• Added a sort button for the main inventory
	• Added missing ammo type tooltip
	• Added team buttons within the character screen gui so you can switch "teams"
	• Added Chicken Cult armor
	• Added Refreshing Charge trait which gives a boost to mana regen at low levels
	• Added Charging Crystal item which can be used in armor crafting
	• Bug: Fixed an issue where the cursor wouldn't line up with when the screen is zoomed in or out
	• Added the mending stream trait which heals you whenever you cast a spell
	• The loop type now takes slightly more mana
	• The loop shape now checks and spends mana for it's children runes for every loop
	• The persistent aoe shape now checks / spends mana for it's children runes for every tick
	• The help ctrl now shows ingredient counts for crafted items
	• Bug: Fixed some issues with correct weapon size with advanced crafting
	• Added Revan's Mending Staff
	• Added a new model for potions so it can be used in advanced crafting
	• You can no longer have multiple damage types at the same spell level
	• Added error message for the spell system when you add mutators to a targeting rune that doesn't accept them
	• Added new background for the crystal expanse biome
	• Crystaline Grass can now be replaced by placing blocks
	• Added Crystaline Wood block
	• Added Crystaline Plank block
	• Fixed tooltip for Alchemy set
	• Added feather model
	• Fixed a symmetry bug in advanced crafting with opacity
	• Added new gem model for Crystal Shards
	• Added gem model for ice shards
	• Added a new chimney model and item. It is purchasable from Vanfyr
	• Added spell void ring which can convert some spell damage to mana
	• Added meteor ore
	• Meteors, surprisingly, now drop meteor ore
	• Reworked NPC dialog UI to look nicer
	• Added a medkit block which can be used to attract "Jane the Healer" to spawn
	• Added Vanfyr's Soulstone block which can be used to spawn vanfyr in your base
	• Reworked the game UI positions due to user complaints
	• Bug: Fixed some of the issues with icons flashing with the abilities on advanced crafted weapons
	• Added INVASIONS to the game
	• Added music for invasions
	• Certain mobs….. Can now open doors
	• Certain mobs can now mine through blocks
	• If no path is found to a player, mobs will attempt to find the closest point to them
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with magic color for the spell equip model
	• Added spell held effect for spells crafted with the earth type
	• Added spell held effect for spells crafted with the fire type
	• Added spell held effect for spells crafted with the arcane type
	• Added spell held effect for spells crafted with the air type
	• Rune targeting shape has been reworked to include different types and allow you to set the number of charges
	• Rune targeting shape can now be cast on interactable objects such as chests and doors and trigger when the object is used
	• Added option for rune targeting shape to block entities… What passes through can be used with the change target mutator
	• You can now charge placed runes by casting the same rune over the top of it
	• Added an option for rune targeting shape which will send you a message if someone activates it
	• Added an option for rune targeting shape which will prevent someone from mining a block until it's charges are complete
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with ai opening doors
	• NPC's can now be targeted and attacked by mobs
	• Invasions now have pre-reqs based on progress
	• Rewrote quest tracking code to Fix several quest related bugs
	• Added a missing tooltip for the advanced craft table quest
	• There is now money loss on death (25% - Easy, 50% - Medium, 100% - Hard)
	• Blinking will now allow you to escape pygmy spears
	• Added a velocity mutator to change projectiles speeds for an increased mana cost
	• Bug: Fixed some spacing issues in the spell creation gui.
	• Bug: Fixed a bug with colors not changing correctly
	• Added arrow of piercing 
	• Added freezing arrow
	• Added damage arrow + 1
	• Added a filter box in the spell create screen to help you search through your spells
	• Added a filter box to the spell design screen to help you search through spell parts
	• Added a watch model for use with the lucky pocket watch
	• Added stalagmites 
	• Bug: Fixed an issue preventing chunks from loading correctly
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with the pyramid dungeon where incorrect blocks would spawn in background
	• Added code to double check and re-request missing chunks
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with NPC mouseover
	• Reduced the size of the rotation handlers in the advanced crafting window
	• Fixed the rotation handler to more accurately rotate in the expected direction
	• Fixed more map bugs
	• Reworked the animation handling to do client side calculations. This means animations are much more responsive for your character.
Bug: Fixed an issue where attack animation's wouldn't play if you were gliding with wings.

There are a few new things snuck in, but mostly we targeted multiplayer stability and fixes. There are a couple of major changes and fixes that took place. notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31251370/b0123d2820ee902978a3a8c1f179ac3d2402686c.png

I just wanted to give a big thanks to all of you who have supported our launch! Of course, launching the game is only the first step. There is still a lot to do! I've gotten a lot of great feedback the last few days and I wanted to get out some fixes for you. Some of the fixes are going to require larger changes and will have to wait for the next major patch. As always, if you have a suggestion or a problem you come across be sure to contact me on the forum or our discord!

Discord Link


Patch Notes 1.0.1.1

	• Reworked how gravity works. I tightened it up so the player doesn't fall as fast. Physics is going to get a larger pass in the next major build.
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with the advanced crafting quests all showing as bows
	• The stoneworks quest no longer consumes your cobblestone
	• Added darkling armor to Captain Sregor's loot list
	• Reworked tower loot slightly
	• Added missing tooltip for spell shape rune unlock
	• Bug: Fixed a tooltip bug with armor inlays
	• Bug: Fixed a bug where you couldn't stab enemies through an open door
	• Grappling hooks can now collide with platforms 
	• Bug: The penetration rune wasn't properly serialized and was causing spell errors
	• Bug: Fixed a bug where a consumable item in your offhand slot could remove an item
	• Bug: Fixed a bug where completing a quest could put an item in your offhand
	• Bug: The necromancer's dungeon quest reward changed to tiny power cores as intended
	• Bug: Fixed a bug where you could close the escape menu while the options were open
	• Bug: Fixed an achievement bug 
	• Bug: Fixed a problem with chest drops that wouldn't drop more than 1 item
	• Bug: Fixed a problem with the spell editor when you left integer fields blank
	• Bug: Xilith, corrupted, and agilite ore had wrong mining power levels. This has been corrected.
	• Reconfigured messages to group creation and removal of entities for better multiplayer performance
	• Bug: Fixed a bug where the player would keep moving when opening menus in game
	• Bug: Platforms no longer block melee attacks
	• Bug: Fixed dungeon skeleton's attack distance
	• Bug: Fixed a problem where the door state check wouldn't communicate properly when a chunk loaded so the door appeared to be closed when it was open.
	• Bug: Fixed a problem where the door could spam its animation
	• Reduced the speed of skeleton casters… it's no longer a marathon to catch them
	• Bug: Fixed a bug with mod loading
	• Bug: Fixed a problem with not getting the base damage rune not appearing
	• Changed how input messages are sent to the server for better multiplayer speed
Bug: Fixed an issue where entities wouldn't be able to request path information and would get stuck

notes.title: Patch 0.6.9.1 - Spellcrafting Revamp
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31251370/34c2c64d18cf11cef7ac4e6e43de348c4e8105b7.png

Patch 0.6.9.1

The new spell crafting changes are here! There was a bit of delay due to some personal issues, but we are quickly getting back on track. There are lots of major changes to this build so we expect some breakage. Most of the spell system has been changed but there are still some effects not reimplemented yet. Be sure to let us know any feedback on discord!

Patch List

	• Bug: Added more check to clear status effects when mobs are killed
	• Added Large bookcase
	• Added Cabinet
	• Added Layered Shelving
	• Added Small Cabinet
	• Added Candelabra
	• Added Globe
	• Added Well Crafted Table
	• Added Wardrobe
	• Bug: Fixed an issue where the power network attempted to setup a removed node
	• Added Apprentice Robes set to the advanced crafting recipes
	• Added Weave Armor set to the advanced crafting armor recipes
	• Added Darkling Armor set to the advanced crafting armor recipes
	• Added better character loading support so a bad character file will still load your other characters
	• Character rotation in create character screen is smoother now
	• The world name now only allows numbers and letters
	• Reversed create world and back button positions
	• Bug: Fixed a text scaling problem in the quest panel
	• You now don't take fall damage when you fall into liquid
	• Added a breath system so you can no longer breath underwater
	• Liquid now decreases the effect 
	• Water now can flow through platforms
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with water flow
	• Reworked water sim to only update cells once during the simulation
	• Reworked the loading process which is in general faster now
	• The "map open" key no longer will close the map or menu to prevent accidental closure (goodbye advanced crafted armor I spent hours on due to an accidental keypress)
	• Removed a gui based memory leak in a support library
	• The Spell system has been completely changed!
	• Spell research has been removed. You now find new runes in the world as well as receive them as quest rewards.
	• The spell research table has been changed to the spell crafting table
	• The spell crafting table is now the spell design table
	• Spell mutator damage has been removed
	• Spell effect rune Fire Damage, Frost Damage, Arcane Damage, and Lightning damage have been combined into just a damage rune. You can now set the damage (num) on this rune as well as set the type of damage it does.
	• Spell effect runes frozen, flow, stun, and disarm have been combined into apply debuff rune
	• Spell effect runes Haste, Invisibility, and slowfall have been combined into apply buff rune
	• Temporarily disabled the 4k gui scaling due to gui framework issues
	• Added memory checks to the profiler screen
	• The penetration rune now has 3 settings: Mobs, Terrain, Both
	• The AoE rune has been modified to be "instant aoe effects" which will instantly apply any children effects in the given area. You can now also set the shape: Circle, Square, Wall and floor.
	• The Location rune has been modified to "persistent aoe effects" which will apply any children effects every tick for so many seconds. You can define the area in the same way as instant aoe.
	• The projectile rune has been reconfigured so you can now set the start location as well as it's travel direction
	• The strike rune has been removed since it's functionality has been moved into instant aoe and persistent aoe
	• The starfall rune has been removed since it's functionality can be replicated with a normal projectile rune
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with setting hotkeys that caused them to show up as unknown
	• Improved spell "beam" performance
	• Added new mutator "Change Target" which allows you to mutate what the spell shape tries to target (IE enemies/ friendly / items etc)
	• Bug: Spell projectiles will no longer target items by default
	• Bug: Fixed an error with hotbar swapping in inventory screens with text input
	• Reworked spell tutorial to use the new system
	• Bug: Fixed text position in tutorial for crafting shark sword components
	• Spells found in the world will now unlock per character so you can see how they are built
	• Bug: Fixed a exception due to quest unlocks
	• Added new quests under the spell tab for new spell system
	• Bug: Fixed a tooltip issue with enchanted bone fragments
	• Bug: Fixed an issue with quest rendering
